notes: Scope is exactly the seven audited corrections; no signature verdict and no estimate was changed.
The two computed numbers fill pre-declared elements that were missing/unreported (MDE; long-tennis mean), per the binding framing rules.
Baseball MDE is reported as a finite lower bound (≈0.33) with the single-order-statistic caveat rather than a clean 'ill-defined' — the data support a computable but too-large MDE.
No engine run, no fetch, no new package; computation files filed under 003/results/, 001&002 content edited in place.
